description: This PHP class 'FormatWithCountryCode' in the OrangeHRM Maintenance module implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format country code values into country names, using a country service to retrieve country details.

classes.name: FormatWithCountryCode
classes.description: Implements ValueFormatter to convert country codes into country names.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the country name associated with the provided country code entity value.
